outgoing.name: Bronze Age
outgoing.section: Early figures: the inspiration of Italy
outgoing.excerpt: After two more intermediary titles, Rodin settled on The Age of Bronze, suggesting the Bronze Age, and in Rodin's words, "man arising from nature".

outgoing.name: Clay
outgoing.excerpt: Sculpturally, he possessed a unique ability to model in clay a complex, turbulent, deeply pocketed surface.

outgoing.name: Mythology
outgoing.excerpt: Rodin's most original work departed from traditional themes of mythology and allegory, modelled the human body with high realism, and celebrated individual character and physicality.
